name: Samara Asset Group plc
summary: Samara Asset Group plc invests in digital assets and companies with blockchain-related business models. It also provides strategic advice services; and invest in biotechnology, financial technology, web3/blockchain, and artificial intelligence. The company formerly known as Cryptology Asset Group plc and changed its name to Samara Asset Group plc in March 2023. Samara Asset Group plc was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Birkirkara, Malta.
